source.market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds futures) are moving dovishly in the same direction, confirming the market isn't just noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs 2y/10y yield changes; verify a broad duration rally rather than an idiosyncratic ETF flow.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (weak data, credit event, geopolitical shock) that would justify a 10-cut tail; if none, fade conviction.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess whether equities/gold/USD are corroborating a risk-off, dovish regime shift.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the rate re-pricing persisted into the next session or mean-reverted; log outcome vs expected direction.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 10 quarter-point cuts (250bps of easing) in 2026 is a deep-recession/crisis scenario. A sharp jump in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive Fed easing, which lowers the whole rate path and rallies long-duration Treasuries. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a large downward rate re-pricing.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check VIX and credit spreads (HYG/LQD) for corroborating risk-off; if calm, treat the equity read as weak.
time_plan.1h: Distinguish 'good-news easing' (soft landing, equities up) from 'bad-news easing' (recession, equities down) via cyclical vs defensive sector rotation.
time_plan.2h: Look for the underlying catalyst; without a growth-scare headline the equity mapping is unreliable.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether SPY move aligned with a risk-off narrative or reversed.
time_plan.12h: Log realized SPY return and whether the recession-signal interpretation held.

predictions.reasoning: Ten cuts in a single year only occur amid a severe growth shock or financial crisis. If the probability of that tail rises sharply, it reflects rising recession/crisis odds, which is net negative for equities despite the easing — the growth signal usually dominates the discount-rate benefit in such regimes. But the sign is ambiguous because 'more cuts' can be read as supportive, hence low confidence.

evidence_used: Market prices 10 cuts (~250bps) of Fed easing in 2026, an extreme tail requiring a recession or crisis
Aggressive easing paths compress the rate curve and rally duration
Deep-easing regimes historically coincide with risk-off equity conditions
uncertainty_notes: This is a tail-probability market; small nominal probability moves may carry little information
Direction of equities is genuinely ambiguous — easing can be bullish (soft landing) or bearish (crisis)
No catalyst is given; we are reasoning from a hypothetical probability shift, not an observed one
A 700bps threshold for 'tradable' is far above realistic 12h moves in these liquid ETFs, so neither prediction is tradable

llm_justification.summary: The market asks about an extreme 10-cut (250bps) Fed easing path in 2026, which is a deep-recession/crisis scenario. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing: bullish for long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and, on balance, mildly bearish for equities (SPY down) if the move reflects a growth scare. Both mappings are low-confidence and the expected 12h magnitudes fall well below the 700bps tradable bar.
key_assumptions: A probability increase in this market reflects genuine expectations of aggressive Fed easing tied to economic deterioration
The dominant driver of such a scenario is growth/crisis fear rather than benign disinflation
TLT and SPY are exposed to shifts in the expected Fed path
failure_modes: The move is noise in a thinly-traded tail market and reverses quickly
Easing is priced as 'good news' (soft landing), making equities rise instead of fall — flipping the SPY sign
The information is already public (existing macro data) and fully reflected in bond/equity prices
Idiosyncratic ETF flows move TLT/SPY without a true duration re-pricing
Expected magnitudes are far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so signals are not actionable even if directionally correct
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
